library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

I selected the antibiotic dataset.
```{r}
antibiotic <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")

gt(head(antibiotic))
```
```{r}
ggplot(antibiotic)

ggplot(antibiotic, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("DID") +
  ggtitle("Defined daily doses per 1,000 inhabitants per day (DID)")
```
